items.title: Hottest May day for nearly 80 years as parts of UK hit heatwave threshold

items.title: Cyprus: Voters boost far right in parliamentary election
items.description: The results dealt a blow to the three centrist parties in President Nikos Christodoulides' minority coalition. The vote is seen as a gauge of voter sentiment ahead of a presidential election in 2028.

items.title: Displaced Ukrainians risk home seizure under Russian law
items.description: Russia is tightening control over property in occupied Ukrainian territories, requiring owners to register under Russian law. Many Ukrainians say returning to do so would put their safety and freedom at risk.

items.title: Trump tells US negotiators 'not to rush' into deal with Iran
items.description: The deal under discussion would involve a 60-day ceasefire extension during which the Strait of Hormuz would be reopened, according to US media.

items.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
items.description: The Oreshnik missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.
